description_en: Queries the status of data sharing for AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-data-share-instances --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --search-value gp-bp000000000000000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDataShareInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs. For information about how to obtain the ID of a resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.help_zh: 实例当前所属的资源组ID。如何获取资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The keyword used to filter instances, which can be an instance ID or instance description.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs and instance descriptions
parameters.help_zh:
搜索关键字，可以根据实例ID或实例描述进行过滤。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID和实例描述
parameters.name: search_value

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30

每页记录数，取值说明：

30

100

parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number
